article.story: MORAGA, Calif. -- — Paulius Murauskas had 20 points and seven rebounds, Mikey Lewis scored 17 points, and Saint Mary's beat Northern Iowa 63-58 on Monday night. Saint Mary's (11-2) shot just 32% (17 of 52) from the field, 4 of 20 from behind the arc, but made 25 of 27 (93%) from the free-throw line. Trey Campbell led Northern Iowa (9-3) with 18 points. Tristan Smith, Leon Bond III and Ismael Diouf scored 10 points apiece. The Panthers hit 3 of 5 from the foul line. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
